scope: Offline SDK convenience-method signature parity inventory
contract: For every Python convenience method, TypeScript exposes a matching method and at least one overload with the same number of positional parameters and required/optional shape; inherited generic methods are included.

validation.python: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sdk.py tests/test_sdk_schema_parity.py tests/test_sdk_method_parity.py -q — 80 passed

boundaries: The static inventory checks method names and argument requiredness; it does not compare parameter types or runtime behavior.
The full focused Python and JavaScript suites use mocked local clients; no HTTP, database, provider, or credential is used.
